allowedDomains.title: Sites agents may act on
allowedDomains.description: When set and not empty, chrome-use refuses any action on a site not covered by this list. A domain covers its subdomains.

blockedDomains.title: Sites agents may not act on
blockedDomains.description: chrome-use refuses every action on these sites. A domain covers its subdomains.

confirmDomains.title: Sites that always ask first
confirmDomains.description: Every action on these sites waits for the user's approval, even on sites the user always allowed.

sensitiveSites.title: Ask first on the built-in sensitive-site list
sensitiveSites.description: Banking, brokerage, crypto exchange and government ID sites. Set to pin it on (true) or off (false); unset leaves it to the user.

ask.title: Always ask before
ask.description: Any of download, sensitive_input (password and payment fields), purchase. Pins the setting; unset leaves it to the user.

firstVisit.title: Ask the first time on a new site
firstVisit.description: Any of navigation, click, typing, upload, download. Pins the setting; unset leaves it to the user.

actionPolicy.title: Action policy
actionPolicy.description: Same shape as a chrome-use --action-policy file, applied on top of the local one: deny refuses an action, confirm makes it wait for the user.

disabledAgents.title: Side-panel agents to turn off
disabledAgents.description: Any of codex, claude, opencode, pi. The side panel does not offer them.
